verdict.rationale: Algolia documents an official CLI for working with its APIs from the terminal. The docs say it suits interactive commands, scripts and CI workflows. It authenticates through a browser sign-in, includes commands like `algolia application list/select`, and runs on macOS, Linux and Windows on both AMD64 and ARM64. An official `algolia-cli` agent skill for managing indices, settings, rules and synonyms ties it directly to AI-agent workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI's use in practice.
